title: ControlCatalogV1
description: LLP 0184 §Design/1. A checked join of every administrative operation's intent, status, authority, effects, input/output schemas, target availability, projections, guide anchor, and agent-access classification. The catalog is a projection of existing owners (LLP 0024 host-operation registry, LLP 0031 route registry, CLI/MCP/AdminClient/console declarations, the Guide manifest) and never a second operation or security authority (§Design/2). Two independent identities exist: the build catalog (this schema) carries schemaVersion/catalogDigest/build identity; the instance availability projection (control-catalog-instance.v1.schema.json) is a separate, smaller artifact served per running target.

catalogDigest.description: Content digest of the normalized `entries` array (JCS-canonicalized), computed by the compiler. Instance projections and clients pin against this to refuse a mismatched build/instance pairing (§Design/1).

generatedAtCommit.description: The commit the compiler ran against; informational, distinct from buildIdentity.sourceCommit which may differ for a dirty tree.

protectedArtifact.description: The secret, approval artifact, or external-custodian material the agent-facing projection must never receive.

negativeLeakTests.description: Checked-in witnesses proving the protected artifact stays out of the agent-facing projection.

MediatedHandoff.description: LLP 0184 rule 6. Required for every mediated row so plan/initiate/status/resume and the negative custody witness remain catalog facts.

RouteClassDomain.description: The domain this row's identity was drawn from (§3's completeness rules and §3a's fifth leg).

operation.description: The stable operation identity. For a row keyed by an LLP 0024 host-op or LLP 0031 route/operation, this is that identity verbatim. For a hosted-adapter row, this is the manifest's `operation` field.

intents.description: Authored, agent-phrased task words for `controls list --intent`. Required non-empty on every catalog row (rule 4/5).

mcpDeferralReason.description: Required when surfaceAccess is cliOnly (§Product contract).

cliDeferralReason.description: Required when surfaceAccess is mcpOnly (§Product contract).

uiLocal.description: Present only on a console/CLI/MCP/AdminClient enumeration entry that is deliberately NOT a catalog operation (rule 2/3).

composedFrom.description: §Design/2: additive, alongside the row's own projections.hostOps/route identity, never a substitute for it. Used for host.restart's MCP projection (composed of host.stop + host.start).

hostOpsDisposition.description: Projection of the LLP 0024 host-operation allowlist owning this hostOps row. Used by generated Guide inventories; absent for non-hostOps rows.

registeredOperations.description: The LLP 0031 multiplexed operation identities registered for this hostOps request spelling. Generated from the registry export so Guide identity counts never parse Rust source text.

projectionCredentials.description: §Design/2's per-projection credential carrier disclosure — required whenever a row's projections disagree on gate (the host.restart case). Keys are projection names (cli/mcp/hostOps/http/adminClient/console/hostedAdapter).

genericInvoke.description: §Design/4: allowlist for `snapback controls invoke`. Never true for mediated/destructive/internal/unavailable rows (checked by the compiler, not just this schema).

guide.description: Guide anchor, e.g. operating/network-profiles.md#set-a-profile. Required (non-null) for every surfaceAccess other than none.

remediation.description: Reserved; stays null/absent until LLP 0146 D7 lands a carrier (§Design/1).

pinned.description: True when this row is refused promotion by the CredentialSecret/ImpersonationCapability rule (§Product contract) regardless of usage evidence.
